children: South Korea's National Pension Service (NPS) has suspended foreign exchange hedging operations, a market source told Reuters on Monday, as the won strengthened to a near two-year high.
"FX hedging by the NPS has been suspended. It seems there is dollar buying demand today," said the source, declining to be identified due to the sensitivity of the matter.
The NPS did not immediately respond to a request for comment.
strengthened as much as 1.15% to 1,334.7 per dollar, its highest since October 4, 2024.
